items.title: File Widerspruch against denial of electric wheelchair
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Friday 20.11.2026; assumed posted same day (no separate posting date given). Under Section 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter sent by post within Germany is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 3rd day after posting: 20.11.2026 + 3 days = 23.11.2026, a Monday, which is a normal working day in NRW, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under Sections 26 SGB X, 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of the event (23.11.2026) is not counted for the start, and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the event day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The due date assumes the letter was actually mailed on its printed date (20.11.2026); if the actual posting date was later, the deadline shifts accordingly.
The letter contains no information suggesting phishing or fraud; sender details appear consistent with a statutory health insurer.
